items.title: Jimmy and Jeannie Cheatham interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 12, 1998
items.q: John Young is one of our friends here.

ctx.x: And in fact who was that, John Young? John Young is one of our friends here. He’s a musician who used to play at the Apollo Theater.

But he’s a very good friend of Milt Hinton’s. And he called us up last week and he said Milt Hinton called him up and told him, “John, I went to a funeral of one of our friends last week.” And John said, “yeah?” He said yeah he was talking to the funeral director and everybody was getting ready to leave, and he said he told the funeral director, gee whiz, I’ve been out here too much this year.
